notes: Firestore creates collections on first document write. This JSON documents the model; it is not a Firebase console import dump.
Storage uses tenants/{tenantId}/tickets/{ticketId}/{slot}, with slots proposal, before and after. Authorization follows the parent ticket.
One tenant per user in this increment.
